digest.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
digest.tldr: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.
